description: Check a section 13 rent increase notice for an assured periodic tenancy in England, served from 1 May 2026: whether the new rent's start date meets each date rule and the notice is on the prescribed form, and the earliest the new rent could start. England only; it does not judge whether the new rent is fair.

history.description: Whether the rent has gone up before after a section 13 notice or a tribunal decision: none, increased (give lastIncrease), or unknown.

lastIncrease.description: If the rent went up before, the day that increase took effect, as YYYY-MM-DD.

period.description: How often the rent falls due.

prescribedForm.description: Whether the notice is on the government's prescribed form for a section 13 notice.

served.description: The day the tenant received the notice, as YYYY-MM-DD.

starts.description: The day the notice says the new rent starts, as YYYY-MM-DD.

tenancyStart.description: The day the first rent period of the tenancy began, as YYYY-MM-DD.

name: check_rent_increase_notice
title: Section 13 rent increase check
